sections.Profile:
The Jetsons pinball machine, produced by Spooky Pinball in collaboration with The Pinball Company in 2017, is a nostalgic tribute to the classic Hanna-Barbera cartoon. Designed to be family-friendly and easy to understand, this game features a colorful playfield with vibrant artwork of the Jetson family.

- Manufacturer: Spooky Pinball LLC
- Years made: 2017
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
- Players: 4
- Tags: 2010s, Licensed, Cartoon, Space, Solid State, TV Show
